title: Helping older adults use AI in everyday life
summary: OpenAI and AARP are bringing free, hands-on ChatGPT workshops to 1,000 older adults across 10 U.S. cities to build practical AI skills safely.
reason: An OpenAI/AARP workshop program for older adults is a corporate education/CSR initiative, not a model release (R1), research artifact (R2), AI business event like financing/M&A/product launch (R3), policy action (R4), or OSS release (R5). No rule covers it.
